title: CASO: Consequence-Aware Semantic Occupancy Evaluation and RiskOcc Training
description: Companion implementation and selected supporting statistics for the manuscript Beyond Accuracy: Consequence-Aware Semantic Occupancy Evaluation and Training for Autonomous Driving. Includes canonical 75/75 scene split, RiskOcc loss/configurations, evaluators and archived evidence for Tables II, III, IV, VII, VIII and IX. Raw datasets, trained checkpoints and complete reproduction packages for Tables I, V and VI are not included. Code: Apache-2.0 with retained third-party notices. Author-produced statistical evidence and new documentation: CC-BY-4.0. This release contains saved evidence, not new experiments. See README.md and docs/AVAILABILITY.md for scope.
